answer: The help center doesn't cover the interest rates offered by Northwind Auto Finance, so I can't tell you what rate you'd get. The articles only explain title handling for Northwind-financed cars: we hold the title as lienholder until the loan is paid in full, then release the lien and mail you the title within 10 business days. In states with electronic titles, we send the release to the state instead. For rate information, please contact a store.
